description: RTRI level crossing road traffic simulator provides linked railway-crossing and street-traffic simulators for evaluating how crossing closure affects road congestion. The provider is Railway Technical Research Institute, Japan. Geographical and temporal coverage: The crossing component uses 0.5-second steps; the street component adapts the INSPECTOR traffic model. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is not stated in inspected metadata. A price for reuse is not established; consult the provider. Caveats: Train-control patterns must be supplied separately. The page does not establish an unrestricted downloadable release. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
